tasks.title: Shared musical analysis and versioned choreography data
tasks.scope: Define a versioned, source-hash-bound intermediate representation for notes, drums, phrases, words/phones, certainty, color, intensity, spatial trajectories and supported fallbacks. Reuse existing event objects rather than creating a competing detector.
tasks.accept: One source analysis feeds both exporters; schema roundtrip, deterministic IDs, stale-cache rejection, exact timestamps and confidence abstention pass.

tasks.title: Universal dual-format XSQ and LMS orchestration
tasks.scope: Prepare default independent exporter attempts from the shared score, native dependency manifests and per-format diagnostic statuses. Preserve existing opt-in CTB16PC paths. Unsupported pixel effects require disclosed musical AC adaptations.
tasks.accept: Tests exercise success/success, success/failure, failure/success, both failure and unsupported capabilities; no silent success, no extension-only compatibility.

tasks.title: CTB16PC and expanded AC controller profiles
tasks.scope: Specify AC16/32/48/64 addressing, fades, intensity, collision checks, cymbal release gaps, phoneme allocations and configured hardware detection.
tasks.accept: Reject >16 circuits per CTB16PC bank, duplicate addresses and ambiguous metadata; preserve low intensity/retrigger roundtrips; licensed LOR import and physical tests remain separately recorded.

tasks.title: Residential layout families and capability-aware adaptations
tasks.scope: Specify eight configurable profiles: AC16, AC32–64, Residential Basic, Residential Standard, Mega Tree, Singing Band, Advanced 3D and Ultimate Helix. Choreograph for each target instead of cropping a large sequence.
tasks.accept: Three pilot songs exercise at least three families including AC16; missing-prop adaptation retains musical phrases and no channel conflicts.

tasks.title: Professional choreography templates and lyric semantics
tasks.scope: Plan phrase arcs, palette design, contrast, intentional darkness, independent groups and finales using authorized vendor demos as references. Preserve note-driven helixes; exact RED/BRIGHT/DIM/DARK/SHIMMER/FLICKER cues require trusted timing.
tasks.accept: Source-labeled timing, density, black/bright contrast and repetitive-pulse metrics reported; semantic effects reach final channel output; no proprietary arrangements copied.

tasks.title: Singing faces and six-snowman band sequence profiles
tasks.scope: Keep six snowmen with one unified keyboard/mallet musician per band for the current direction. Preserve standalone models, distinct mouth circuits and evidence-backed independent vocal lanes.
tasks.accept: Native face and instrument cue parity, no invented singers from mixed vocal buses, contact/idle checks and <=16 AC circuits per model; identity uncertainty disclosed.

tasks.title: Advanced 3D worlds and musical spatial adaptation
tasks.scope: Plan spatial transforms, front-view parity, spiral groves, moire/forced perspective, giant double helixes and integrated snowman stages.
tasks.accept: Native xLights 3D load/render, valid groups/assets/transforms, 88 disjoint MIDI rungs and channel parity; historical intermediate XML migrated before compatibility claims.

tasks.title: Automatic layout matching and reviewable remapping
tasks.scope: Inventory props, models/groups, pixels/channels, controllers, spatial positions, faces, trees/arches and custom submodels. Rank profiles; offer deterministic semantic remaps with user review.
tasks.accept: Golden layouts include fewer/missing props, duplicate names, mixed controllers and collisions; stable ranking, explicit unsupported effects and no silent mapping acceptance.

tasks.title: Native import/export validation and compatibility matrix
tasks.scope: Record exact xLights/LOR application versions and distinguish XML structure, successful native import, rendering and physical playback. Cover desktop/Android export and large jobs.
tasks.accept: Native xLights import/render parity and audio synchronization pass on supported versions; licensed LOR and actual hardware checks are blocked when unavailable, never reported green.

tasks.title: Eligible free music catalog and metadata lineage
tasks.scope: Design stable song IDs, byte/PCM hashes, durations, fingerprints, alternate-version lineage, HelixXMix/hardKor metadata and song-specific distribution evidence. Filter by profile/controller/channel/pixel/prop/complexity/software support.
tasks.accept: No same-name deduplication; source originals untouched; catalog filters and provenance checks pass; no bulk publication or Drive sharing changes during planning.

tasks.title: Resumable cached pilot and batch-generation pipeline
tasks.scope: Use source+analysis-version+score+profile+exporter hashes for stage caches. Isolate failures, atomic artifacts, per-format statuses and resumable jobs. Start with three songs only after Gate B.
tasks.accept: Interrupt/resume yields identical validated outputs without duplicate work; stale dependencies invalidate only descendants; pilot approval required before catalog-wide runs.

tasks.title: Review download packaging, previews and import instructions
tasks.scope: Specify Song/Layout Variant/xLights and LOR/Models/Instructions/Preview packages, compatibility manifests, checksums and browsable index. Respect free-homeowner/commercial distinctions.
tasks.accept: ZIP CRC and required-file checks, relative assets, actual playable MP4/source correspondence, verified import instructions and explicit compatibility limitations; publication separate approval.
